existing.description: The Suborno Jayanti Scholarship Scheme is the ICCR scheme for nationals of Bangladesh, subsuming the earlier Bangladesh schemes previously offered by ICCR. Under it, the Government of India through ICCR provides scholarship at UG, PG and Ph.D level in Indian universities. Applications are made online on the ICCR A2A Scholarship Portal and must be submitted through the Indian Mission in the applicant's country, which then forwards them to empanelled Indian State and Central Universities. Registration for the 2026-27 academic year is closed and the portal currently lists 2026-27 as the only registration year.
eligibility: 18-30 years old for UG/PG (as of 1 July of the academic year)
PhD applicants must be under 45 (as of 1 July of the academic year)
Must submit SSC/HSC-equivalent mark sheets and transcripts in English
Excludes Medicine/Paramedical/Nursing, Fashion, Law, and integrated 5-year programmes
existing.eligibility_summary: 18-30 years old for UG/PG; PhD applicants must be under 45 (as of 1 July of the academic year). Must submit SSC/HSC-equivalent mark sheets and transcripts in English. Excludes Medicine/Paramedical/Nursing, Fashion, Law, and integrated 5-year BA-LLB/BSc-MSc programmes.
benefits: Full tuition at an Indian govt./public university
Hostel accommodation (subject to availability; campus hostel mandatory if available)
coverage: Full tuition at an Indian govt./public university
Hostel accommodation (subject to availability; campus hostel mandatory if available)
requirements: Mandatory 500-word English essay on a topic assigned inside the A2A portal
IELTS/TOEFL scores are additional proof, not a substitute for the essay
Passport must have minimum 2 years validity as of 1 July of the academic year
Medical insurance policy with minimum INR 5,00,000 sum assured required
documents: SSC/HSC (or equivalent) mark sheets and transcripts in English
Proof of English proficiency (500-word essay on an A2A-assigned topic, OR TOEFL/IELTS score)
Medical insurance policy with minimum INR 5,00,000 sum assured
Passport copy (minimum 2 years validity as of 1 July of the academic year)
existing.english_requirement: Mandatory 500-word English essay on a topic assigned inside the A2A portal - applies regardless of IELTS/TOEFL. Test scores are additional proof, not a substitute for the essay.
application_method: Step 1: Register at sjsdhaka.gov.in (Bangladesh-specific Suborno Jayanti portal) FIRST
Step 2: Register at a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in (ICCR A2A portal)
Select up to 5 university preferences in order of preference
Submit application before the deadline (direct A2A registration without Step 1 gets rejected)
existing.selection_notes: Selection by Indian Missions/Posts. Offer letter issued by Indian Mission; applicant must accept/reject within 7 days on A2A Portal. Medical fitness upload required within prescribed time limit after acceptance.
existing.best_fit: Accessible - 500 seats for Bangladesh alone under Suborno Jayanti, covers UG through PhD, workable for students without IELTS since the essay route is standard, not a fallback
existing.notes: Two-step registration required: sjsdhaka.gov.in (Bangladesh-specific portal) FIRST, then a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in - direct A2A registration without the first step gets rejected. Up to 5 university preferences allowed. Stipend and allowance figures are per the official ICCR Policy Guidelines for AY 2026-27. Scholarship allowances disbursed based on academic progress; failure to promote to next level means no allowances until backlog cleared.
existing.duration: Up to 3 years for PhD (extendable up to 2 years at discretion of university); varies by programme for UG/PG
existing.program_type: Government scholarship (500 seats for Bangladesh under Suborno Jayanti)

scholarships.title: DAAD Scholarship
scholarships.degree: Mostly Master's/PhD (a few UG-eligible programmes exist but are rare)

existing.description: The DAAD scholarship database is the German Academic Exchange Service's official listing of its own funding programmes for international students and researchers, together with offers from other selected funding organisations. At the time of verification it returned 150 scholarship options, searchable by country, applicant type, scholarship purpose, subject and programme title. Applications are submitted to the specific programme rather than to a single central DAAD form, and each programme sets its own eligibility, deadline and award conditions. The database also links to the external funding guide www.funding-guide.de.
eligibility: Most recent degree completed no more than 6 years before the deadline
Exact GPA/academic requirements are set per individual programme, not centrally by DAAD
existing.eligibility_summary: Most recent degree completed no more than 6 years before the deadline. No general age limit. Exact GPA/academic requirements are set per individual programme, not centrally by DAAD.
benefits: Monthly stipend: EUR 992 (Master's) / EUR 1,300 (PhD/doctoral) - figures current as of 2025/26
Health, accident, and personal liability insurance
coverage: Monthly stipend: EUR 992 (Master's) / EUR 1,300 (PhD/doctoral) - figures current as of 2025/26
Health, accident, and personal liability insurance
requirements: Depends on programme - many require IELTS/TOEFL for English-taught programmes
Some require German proficiency instead or in addition
documents: Language certificates (German and/or English depending on programme)
existing.english_requirement: Depends on programme - many require IELTS/TOEFL for English-taught programmes; some require German proficiency instead or in addition
application_method: Apply directly via DAAD scholarship database (daad.de)
Select programme filtered by Bangladesh + degree level
Submit application through the DAAD portal before the programme-specific deadline
existing.selection_notes: Selection by independent committees assessing professional qualifications, study/research project quality, and applicant potential. Special circumstances (e.g. disability) may be considered.
existing.best_fit: Best for Master's/PhD applicants who already have a specific field/programme in mind - not one unified scholarship, requires researching individual programme listings
existing.notes: DAAD is NOT a single scholarship - it is a database of 100+ separately funded programmes, each with its own eligibility/deadline/coverage. Figures above are current as of 2025/26. Must check the specific programme on DAAD's Funding Guide database (daad.de), filtered by Bangladesh + degree level, before advising a user. Funded by the German Federal Foreign Office.
existing.duration: 10-24 months for Master's programmes; up to 4 years for PhD (initial award up to 3 years, extendable)
existing.application_period: Varies by programme - typically Sept-Nov for a Oct/Nov deadline; check DAAD database per programme
existing.deadline_display: Varies by programme - Master's typically ~30 Oct; PhD programmes vary (3 Sept or 21 Oct for 2026/27 cycle). Deadlines updated annually in Q2.
